items.title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
items.overview: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

items.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
items.overview: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

items.title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
items.overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

items.title: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
items.overview: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

items.listTitle: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
items.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
items.overview: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

items.listTitle: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
items.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
items.overview: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

items.title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
items.overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

items.listTitle: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
items.title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
items.overview: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

items.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
items.overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

items.title: Stamptown
items.overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

items.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
items.overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

items.listTitle: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
items.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
items.overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

items.listTitle: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

items.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
items.overview: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

items.listTitle: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
items.title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
items.overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

items.title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
items.overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

items.listTitle: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
items.title: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
items.overview: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

items.listTitle: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
items.title: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
items.overview: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

items.listTitle: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
items.title: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
items.overview: Follows Hannah Berner as she questions her future, exposes her unorthodox career path, dishes dating secrets and admits she's "part-time hot."

items.listTitle: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
items.title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
items.overview: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

items.title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
items.overview: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

items.title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
items.overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

items.listTitle: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
items.title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
items.overview: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

items.title: The Roast of Kevin Hart
items.overview: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

items.title: Nikki Glaser: Good Girl
items.overview: Considered one of the most fearless voices in modern comedy, Nikki Glaser delivers a brutally honest special that takes on aging, beauty, and fame - confronting what it means to stay relevant, desirable, and real in a culture that never looks away.

items.title: KillTonyMania
items.overview: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

items.title: Ramy Youssef: In Love
items.overview: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

items.listTitle: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
items.title: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
items.overview: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

items.listTitle: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
items.title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
items.overview: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

items.title: Sheng Wang: Purple
items.overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

items.title: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
items.overview: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.

items.title: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
items.overview: Aussie comic Aaron Chen riffs on the absurdities of life in the U.S., from New York City sidewalk riddles to unexpected news sources, with deadpan wit.

items.listTitle: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
items.title: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
items.overview: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.

items.title: Kountry Wayne: Nostalgia
items.overview: Nostalgia is full of funny and hilarious moments mixed with the truth. It reminds us of how comedy was back in the day. It gives us that '90s feel-that funny, raw, fun, hard, Def Jam laughter-but at the same time, it holds informational, truthful, and enlightening moments. It's full of laughter, and it's the nostalgia of how you felt back in the day… before AI existed!

items.title: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
items.overview: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.

items.title: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
items.overview: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

items.title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
items.overview: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

items.listTitle: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
items.title: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
items.overview: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

items.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
items.overview: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

items.title: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
items.overview: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

items.title: Katt Williams: The Last Report
items.overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

items.title: Mo Gilligan: In the Moment
items.overview: Mo Gilligan takes on Hollywood — and lives to tell the tale. In this lively special, the Londoner dishes on fame, family and being British in America.

items.title: Mike Epps: Delusional
items.overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

items.listTitle: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas
items.title: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas
items.overview: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin showcase.

items.title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
items.overview: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

items.title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
items.overview: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

items.listTitle: Rick Mercer: Stand Up for Canada
items.title: Rick Mercer: Stand Up for Canada
items.overview: Rick Mercer Stand Up for Canada is a one-hour CBC comedy special where Mercer is joined by Sophie Buddle, Mayce Galoni, and Julie Kim for a sharp and heartfelt celebration of Canada.

items.title: Tom Segura: Teacher
items.overview: Parenting fails. Blackout bar stories. Career regrets. Tom Segura explores the darkly funny side of life's most unpredictable lessons.

items.title: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable...
items.overview: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

items.title: Kumail Nanjiani: Night Thoughts
items.overview: After nearly a decade away, Kumail Nanjiani returns to Chicago, where he got his start in standup, in a new special that tackles anxiety, the perils of buying drugs pre-legalization, and most importantly, cat medication.

items.title: Robby Hoffman: Wake Up
items.overview: Breakout star Robby Hoffman hilariously pushes the limits of comedy with red-hot, controversial takes in her debut special.

items.listTitle: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh
items.title: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh
items.overview: After four seasons (and counting) on Saturday Night Live, Sarah Sherman's unholy alter ego, Sarah Squirm, slithers onto your screen and rips off the straitjacket, unleashing a festering and hilarious hour of bodily fluids, open-wound confessionals, and jokes that will leave scars on your soul.

items.listTitle: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special
items.title: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special
items.overview: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.

items.title: Kevin Hart: Acting My Age
items.overview: Older, wiser — and still hilarious. Kevin Hart opens up about his midlife mishaps, from intimacy pills to the perils of unexpected injuries.

items.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right
items.overview: Filmed live at the legendary United Center arena in Chicago, Sebastian Maniscalco goes all in on family chaos, aging, and the little things that drive us all nuts—with his one-of-a-kind comedic bite.

items.title: Kathleen Madigan: The Family Thread
items.overview: Comedian Kathleen Madigan is back with her latest stand up comedy special focusing on teaching kids math through gambling and Fantasy Football, celebrating Midwest pioneers, raising 4 "feral" cats, managing aging parents and modern ideas for the Catholic Church to compete with Megachurches.

items.listTitle: Gerry Dee: Funny You Should Say That
items.title: Gerry Dee: Funny You Should Say That
items.overview: With dry wit, Canadian comic Gerry Dee explores his perilous years as a schoolteacher, the pitfalls of open marriages and the truth about Santa.

items.title: Leanne Morgan: Unspeakable Things
items.overview: Leanne Morgan discusses her rise to fame, family matters, and her one-time CBD experience.

items.title: Mo Amer: Wild World
items.overview: In this fearlessly honest special, Mo Amer honors his Palestinian roots, recounts confrontations on the road and relives becoming a father.

items.title: Leslie Jones: Life Part 2
items.overview: Leslie Jones tackles aging, relationships, fame, and life's unexpected twists with the kind of honesty and fire only she can bring.

items.title: Michelle Wolf: The Well
items.overview: Michelle Wolf gets real about white women, serial killers and adjusting to motherhood in this sharp, unfiltered stand-up special.

items.listTitle: An Intimate Evening with Adam Pally
items.title: An Intimate Evening with Adam Pally
items.overview: Equal parts stand-up, documentary, and rock concert, Adam Pally plays with the truth and his guitar in a one-time-only performance.

items.title: Frankie Quiñones: Damn That's Crazy
items.overview: Frankie Quiñones hits the stage to unpack love, addiction, and the high-stakes politics of the family carne asada.

items.title: Matt McCusker: A Humble Offering
items.overview: From wife logic to locker-room shame, Matt McCusker offers witty takes on manhood, marriage and raising daughters in a world he barely understands.

items.title: Earthquake: Joke Telling Business
items.overview: From unpacking celebrity scandals to hot takes on love, legendary comic Earthquake shakes things up in this explosive stand-up set.

items.title: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
items.overview: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

items.title: Caleb Hearon: Model Comedian
items.overview: ​In his debut stand-up special, actor, comedian, writer, and podcaster Caleb Hearon takes us back to his roots in Kansas City...where it all started. Newly 30, Hearon deploys his generational Midwestern wisdom to solve most of the world's problems: politics, internet trolls, learning we're not that different from our parents, and more.

items.title: Andrew Santino: White Noise
items.overview: Andrew Santino's new hilarious stand-up special will undoubtedly solve all the world's problems for eternity.

items.listTitle: Larry the Cable Guy: It's a Gift
items.title: Larry the Cable Guy: It's a Gift
items.overview: A stand-up special featuring Larry the Cable Guy at his best, delivering all new jokes with his signature rapid fire wit. Filmed at the historic Capitol Theater in Clearwater, Florida, this high energy show is packed with laughs and classic Larry charm.

items.title: Lil Rel Howery: Rel Talk
items.overview: Lil Rel Howery brings his signature humor to Chicago's What's Funny Comedy Festival in a personal, hilarious, high-energy stand-up performance.

items.listTitle: Kill Tony: Mayhem at Madison Square Garden
items.title: Kill Tony: Mayhem at Madison Square Garden
items.overview: With one minute to impress Tony Hinchcliffe and his star-studded panel, newbie stand-ups risk it all on the hallowed ground of Madison Square Garden.

items.title: Jim Jefferies: Two Limb Policy
items.overview: Comedian Jim Jefferies unleashes his thoughts on tiny mustaches, straight-guy struggles and why acting doesn't count as a real job.

items.title: Ralph Barbosa: Planet Bosa
items.overview: Ralph Barbosa shares his adventures in dating, controlling his temper, working on cars, and his views on current events.

items.title: Marc Maron: Panicked
items.overview: Comedian and podcaster Marc Maron offers up his nuanced perspective on our increasingly uncertain world.

items.title: Vir Das: Fool Volume
items.overview: Whether it's the police, the evil eye or a badly timed lost voice, comedian Vir Das explores how embracing foolishness has led him to shared happiness.

items.title: Zarna Garg: Practical People Win
items.overview: Zarna Garg is bringing the heat (and the guilt trips) in her laugh-out-loud Hulu debut, taking aim at husbands, kids, in-laws, and anyone who dares question an Indian mom's wisdom.

items.listTitle: It's Worth It by Dani Rovira
items.title: It's Worth It by Dani Rovira
items.overview: Actor and comedian Dani Rovira returns to the stage with an honest and hilarious take on finding light even in life's darkest moments.

items.title: Nate Jackson: Super Funny
items.overview: Sharp jokes meet savage roasts as Nate Jackson blends his infamous crowd work with takes on topics from judgment-free gyms to catfishing.

items.title: Steph Tolev: Filth Queen
items.overview: Bow down to the queen as fearlessly filthy Steph Tolev rules the stage with hilarious confessions, unfiltered dating stories and absurd observations.

items.title: Justin Willman: Magic Lover
items.overview: Follows an entertaining show that combines between performing magic tricks and delivering comedic commentary on different themes.

items.title: Atsuko Okatsuka: Father
items.overview: Fans call her 'Mother,' but Atsuko is 'Father'—thriving professionally yet clueless about basics. A 7-year laundry hiatus and learning that marriage licenses precede weddings are just some hilariously relatable discoveries she shares in her special.

items.title: Mike Birbiglia: The Good Life
items.overview: Drugs. Marriage. Kids' parties. Mike Birbiglia reevaluates life as a son — and as a father — in this hilarious and deeply personal comedy special.

items.title: Jerrod Carmichael: Don't Be Gay
items.overview: Jerrod Carmichael returns to the stage for his fourth HBO stand-up special.

items.title: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
items.overview: After losing her parents, Sarah Silverman finds laughter and solace in celebrating their lives, from deathbed binge-watching to an ill-timed fart.

items.listTitle: Matteo Lane: The Al Dente Special
items.title: Matteo Lane: The Al Dente Special
items.overview: Matteo Lane shares stories from his life, travels and family - like chatting with a friend over brunch.

items.title: David Spade: Dandelion
items.overview: With signature sardonic takes on the perils of flying, Travis & Taylor, charity auctions, and the evolution of porn, David Spade is sharper and funnier than ever.

items.listTitle: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
items.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
items.overview: Emmy-winning actor, writer, and comedian Brett Goldstein brings his irresistible charm and quick wit stateside for his first HBO stand-up special. Best known for the hit shows "Ted Lasso" and "Shrinking", Goldstein sheds his testy Roy Kent façade to share his hilarious insights on love, sex, masculinity, "Sesame Street", and everything in between.

items.title: Jessica Kirson: I'm the Man
items.overview: Jessica Kirson shares her searing perspective on everything from TikTok girls to her bizarre time at a trauma center.

items.title: Tim Dillon: I'm Your Mother
items.overview: The fearlessly edgy Tim Dillon shares his signature comedic rants on everything from homelessness to why he'd never leave the British royal family.

items.listTitle: Kill Tony: Kill or Be Killed
items.title: Kill Tony: Kill or Be Killed
items.overview: A bucket, a mic and one minute to win over Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests. This is stand-up at its most unforgiving — and unpredictable.

items.title: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
items.overview: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

items.title: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
items.overview: Losing 45 pounds. Getting parenting advice from Snoop Dogg. Bert Kreischer knows he's the luckiest guy around — and he's recounting his blessings.

items.title: Bill Burr: Drop Dead Years
items.overview: In what might be his most personal and introspective hour yet, Bill offers hilarious takes on everything from male sadness to dating advice.

items.title: Iliza Shlesinger: A Different Animal
items.overview: Acclaimed comedian Iliza Shlesinger debuts on Amazon Prime with a no-holds-barred, explosive and relentlessly funny hour special where she covers everything from shower sex, ugly wives and the ideal man to the truth about the ONE thing no woman wants… in this special, nothing is off limits.

items.title: Andrew Schulz: LIFE
items.overview: In this razor-sharp yet heartfelt special, Andrew Schulz unpacks the wildest moment of his life — becoming a father.

items.title: Chris Distefano: It's Just Unfortunate
items.overview: Chris Distefano is trying to be the best father he can be but nowadays, words speak louder than actions—so Chris is acting with the right intentions, but not always the right moves.

items.title: Rosebud Baker: The Mother Lode
items.overview: Rosebud Baker delivers a raw and hilarious look at motherhood in all its chaotic beauty — filmed both before and after giving birth.

items.title: George Lopez: Muy Católico
items.overview: George Lopez brings his reflections on aging, Latino family dynamics, and cultural quirks in his final stand-up special. He hilariously embraces the challenges of getting older and touches on generational clashes and Latino superstitions. Bold and personal, Lopez delivers his comedic voice to stories that capture both the humor and heart of his journey one last time.

items.title: Felipe Esparza: Raging Fool
items.overview: In a furiously funny special, Felipe Esparza riffs on his tough-love Mexican mom, keeping a marriage spicy and why dairy is more dangerous than drugs.

items.title: Liza Treyger: Night Owl
items.overview: Treyger's stand-up explores the struggles of new parenthood, venting frustrations about others' spouses, and self-deceptions around substance use.

items.listTitle: Tom Green: I Got a Mule!
items.title: Tom Green: I Got a Mule!
items.overview: Tom Green shares humorous insights about his experience transitioning from Hollywood to a simpler lifestyle in the countryside. He also provides amusing observations about modern social media pitfalls and other relatable topics.

items.title: Roy Wood Jr.: Lonely Flowers
items.overview: In this stand-up special, Roy Wood Jr explores how lack of connection has sent society spiraling into a culture full of guns, rude employees, self-checkout lanes, and why some of us would rather be alone rather than be connected.

items.title: Ari Shaffir: America's Sweetheart
items.overview: Comedian Ari Shaffir tackles controversial topics like terrorism, gun violence, racism, and more in his stand-up special. With a darkly humorous approach, he explores unexpected perspectives on sensitive social and political issues.

items.listTitle: Bill Maher: Is Anyone Else Seeing This?
items.title: Bill Maher: Is Anyone Else Seeing This?
items.overview: With his signature sardonic wit and unfiltered approach, acclaimed comedian Bill Maher offers up his scathing commentary on the hypocrisies of both conservative and liberal politics, as well as trends in modern parenting, sex and dating, and religion.

items.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Legend of Fluffy
items.overview: From breaking stereotypes to home break-ins, Gabriel Iglesias brings comedy to life's unexpected twists in this stand-up special.

items.listTitle: Michelle Buteau: A Buteau-ful Mind at Radio City Music Hall
items.title: Michelle Buteau: A Buteau-ful Mind at Radio City Music Hall
items.overview: Michelle Buteau talks going viral, raising twins, and the lows of getting high in this herstory-making special.

items.listTitle: Torching 2024: A Roast of the Year
items.title: Torching 2024: A Roast of the Year
items.overview: Roastmaster General Jeff Ross and a cast of comedians look back at 2024’s most memorable moments in a night of savage laughs and surprises.

items.title: Your Friend, Nate Bargatze
items.overview: In his third Netflix special, Nate Bargatze tackles pizza-ordering strategies for guys' night, wanting a second dog and relying on his responsible wife.

items.title: Nate Bargatze's Nashville Christmas
items.overview: This highly anticipated holiday event, hosted by the beloved comedian Nate Bargatze, promises a night filled with laughter, heartwarming performances, and holiday spirit. Featuring a lineup of special guest appearances, live music, and comedic acts, the show brings the magic of Christmas to the iconic Grand Ole Opry in Nashville.

items.title: Ilana Glazer: Human Magic
items.overview: Ilana Glazer's unfiltered stand-up special dives into life's down and dirty truths, from painfully awkward high school years to navigating parenthood as a stoner mom.

items.listTitle: Rose Matafeo: On and On and On
items.title: Rose Matafeo: On and On and On
items.overview: Building her hour-long set around a 16,000-word note kept over time on her phone, Rose Matafeo leans into her insightful and self-deprecating humor to share candid takes on relationships – from dating in her 20s vs. 30s to supporting friends through breakups and the stark differences between herself and her parents at the same age.

items.listTitle: Ronny Chieng: Love to Hate It
items.title: Ronny Chieng: Love to Hate It
items.overview: Ronny Chieng unpacks fertility treatment fiascoes, the dark side of men's self-help and scam-sensitive parents.

items.title: Joe Mande: Chill
items.overview: Joe Mande hilariously (and calmly) shares his thoughts on the topics of love, basketball, gun control, mayonnaise, and the size of animal genitalia.

items.listTitle: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
items.title: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
items.overview: Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning actor. Grammy-winning singer. Beloved comedian. Jamie Foxx returns to the stage to set the record straight.

items.title: Fortune Feimster: Crushing It
items.overview: From no longer being her mom's stand-in husband to a "romantic" honeymoon with her wife, Fortune Feimster is crushing it in this feel-good special.

items.listTitle: The World According to Kaleb - On Tour
items.title: The World According to Kaleb - On Tour
items.overview: Filmed live at the Cheltenham Everyman Theatre, this special captures Kaleb Cooper's humorous takes on farming, life, and his unique perspectives on British culture.

items.title: Anthony Jeselnik: Bones and All
items.overview: Anthony Jeselnik celebrates 20 years of delivering boundary-pushing comedy to the masses in this razor-sharp stand-up special.

items.title: Jeff Dunham's Scrooged-Up Holiday Special
items.overview: Jeff Dunham tries to to recreate the beloved holiday story, A Christmas Carol, with his iconic characters in the classic roles. Walter is obvious – there's only one man who can play Scrooge! But when Jeff assigns Bubba J, Peanut, Little Jeff and Achmed their thespian parts, they don't quite agree and his plan spins hilariously out-of-control.

items.title: Adrienne Iapalucci: The Dark Queen
items.overview: Comedian Adrienne Iapalucci takes aim at our public figures, awkward tribute tattoos, virtue signaling and more in this unfiltered stand-up special.

items.title: Tom Papa: Home Free
items.overview: From the sheer bliss of a hot shower to the saucy joys of an empty nest, Tom Papa tackles aging, parenthood and more in this witty comedy special.
